title: Make the agentic assistant the default with legacy planner fallback
observed_behavior: assistant.agentic.enabled defaulted false, so enabled assistants used the legacy plan/approve planner unless operators explicitly opted into the multi-step agentic loop. Agentic provider fields did not consistently inherit legacy llm_* configuration when the agentic base URL remained at the default OpenAI URL.
intended_behavior: The assistant defaults to the multi-step agentic loop in audited permission mode. Deployments that configure assistant.llm_model, assistant.llm_base_url, and assistant.llm_api_key continue to work because empty or default agentic provider fields inherit those legacy fields before validation and app wiring. Operators can explicitly set assistant.agentic.enabled=false to run the legacy planner without changing the existing llm_streaming or fallback paths.
authoritative_contract: bahia-yu6g acceptance criteria: default assistant.agentic.enabled=true; legacy llm_* fields populate effective agentic provider config when agentic fields are omitted; explicit assistant.agentic.enabled=false remains the legacy planner escape hatch; validation points operators at either assistant.agentic.model or assistant.llm_model when no effective model exists.
